"2", "value": "48"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "43"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "38"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Use the direct formula for overlapping groups:

\n

Weight of Amit = (Total of Anwar and Amit) + (Total of Amit and Gopal) − (Total of all three)

\n

Amit's weight = (2 × 39) + (2 × 44) − (3 × 46)

\n

Amit's weight = 78 + 88 − 138

\n

Amit's weight = 166 − 138 = 28 kg

\n

∴ The correct answer is 28 kg.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n\n

Given:

\n

Average weight of Anwar, Amit, and Gopal = 46 kg

\n

Average weight of Anwar and Amit = 39 kg

\n

Average weight of Amit and Gopal = 44 kg

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Total weight of Anwar, Amit, and Gopal = 46 × 3 = 138 kg

\n

⇒ Total weight of Anwar and Amit = 39 × 2 = 78 kg

\n

⇒ Total weight of Amit and Gopal = 44 × 2 = 88 kg

\n

⇒ Sum of weights of the two groups = 78 + 88 = 166 kg

\n

⇒ In the sum above, Amit's weight has been counted twice.

\n

⇒ Weight of Amit = Sum of the two groups − Total weight of all three

\n

⇒ Weight of Amit = 166 − 138 = 28 kg

\n

∴ The correct answer is 28 kg.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n

Overlapping Groups Average

\n

When a central term is counted twice between two partial groups, its exact value can be calculated as: Value of overlapping term = Sum of the overlapping parts − Total sum of all elements.

\n\n

Combined Average

\n

If two sets of sizes n1 and n2 have individual averages A1 and A2 respectively, their combined average is given by the formula (n1A1 + n2A2) ÷ (n1 + n2).

\n\n

Deviation Method for Averages

\n

The total sum of deviations of all the given observations from their true average is always zero. This principle provides a quick way to find missing values without multiplying large numbers.

\n\n

আনোয়ার এবং অমিতের গড় ওজন = 39 কেজি।

অমিত এবং গোপালের গড় ওজন = 44 কেজি।

\n\n

গড় = মানের যোগফল / মানের সংখ্যা

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

ধরা যাক আনোয়ার, অমিত এবং গোপালের ওজন যথাক্রমে A, B এবং G।

\n\n

আনোয়ার, অমিত এবং গোপালের মোট ওজন = 46 x 3 = 138 কেজি।

\n\n

\n\n

অমিত এবং গোপালের মোট ওজন = 44 x 2 = 88 কেজি।

উপরের থেকে:

\n\n

⇒ A + B = 78

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

(A + B = 78) থেকে:

\n\n

{"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

The smallest natural number divisible by a given set of numbers is their LCM.

\n

Given numbers: 5, 10, 49, 28.

\n

Identify the highest power of prime factors present in these numbers: 22 (from 28), 51 (from 5 or 10), and 72 (from 49).

\n

LCM = 22 × 51 × 72 = 4 × 5 × 49 = 980

\n

∴ The correct answer is 980.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

The numbers are 5, 10, 49, and 28.

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Smallest divisible number = Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given numbers.

\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Prime factorization of 5 = 5

\n

⇒ Prime factorization of 10 = 2 × 5

\n

⇒ Prime factorization of 49 = 7 × 7 = 72

\n

⇒ Prime factorization of 28 = 2 × 2 × 7 = 22 × 7

\n

⇒ To find the LCM, we take the highest power of each distinct prime factor present in all the factorizations.

\n

⇒ The distinct prime factors are 2, 5, and 7.

\n

⇒ Highest power of 2 is 22

\n

⇒ Highest power of 5 is 51

\n

⇒ Highest power of 7 is 72

\n

⇒ LCM = 22 × 51 × 72

\n

⇒ LCM = 4 × 5 × 49

\n

⇒ LCM = 20 × 49

\n

⇒ LCM = 980

\n

∴ The correct answer is 980.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

\n

The smallest positive integer that is perfectly divisible by each of the given numbers. It is computed by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors involved.

\n

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

\n

The largest positive integer that divides each of the numbers without leaving a remainder. It is formed by multiplying the lowest powers of only the common prime factors.

\n

Relationship between LCM and HCF

\n

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. The formula is: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

વિભાજ્યતા માટે આપેલી સંખ્યાઓ: 5, 10, 49, અને 28.

\n\n

ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

\n\n

ઘણી સંખ્યાઓથી વિભાજ્ય સૌથી નાની સંખ્યા એ તેમનો લઘુત્તમ સામાન્ય ગુણાંક (LCM) છે.

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

5, 10, 49, અને 28 નો LCM શોધો:

\n\n

અવિભાજ્ય અવયવીકરણ:

\n\n

5 = 5

\n\n

10 = 2 x 5

\n\n

49 = 72

\n\n

28 = 2 x 2 x 7

\n\n

LCM માં બધા અવિભાજ્ય અવયવોની સૌથી વધુ ઘાત શામેલ છે:

\n\n

LCM = 22 x 5 x 72

\n\n

⇒ LCM = 4 x 5 x 49

\n\n

⇒ LCM = 20 x 49

\n\n

⇒ LCM = 980

\n\n

5, 10, 49, અને 28 થી વિભાજ્ય સૌથી નાની પ્રાકૃતિક સંખ્યા 980 છે.

\n\n

ಭಾಗಾಕಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ನೀಡಲಾದ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು: 5, 10, 49 ಮತ್ತು 28.

\n\n

ಬಳಸಲಾದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

\n\n

ಅನೇಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಅತಿಚಿಕ್ಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಲಘುತ್ತಮ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಪವರ್ತ್ಯ (ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ.) ಆಗಿದೆ.

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

5, 10, 49 ಮತ್ತು 28 ರ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. ಅನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ:

\n\n

ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಅಪವರ್ತನೀಕರಣ:

\n\n

5 = 5

\n\n

10 = 2 x 5

\n\n

49 = 72

\n\n

28 = 2 x 2 x 7

\n\n

ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಅಪವರ್ತನಗಳ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಘಾತವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ:

\n\n

ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 22 x 5 x 72

\n\n

⇒ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 4 x 5 x 49

\n\n

⇒ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 20 x 49

\n\n

⇒ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 980

\n\n

5, 10, 49 ಮತ್ತು 28 ರಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 980 ಆಗಿದೆ.
